SELECT SUM(r.refund_amount_twd), COUNT(*) FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=r.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id WHERE c.tier='G' AND datetime(r.refund_ts,'+8 hours') >= '2025-01-01' AND datetime(r.refund_ts,'+8 hours') < '2026-01-01'
